My new game a pet shop after dark is out now. It's a horror point-and-click adventure! There's a 10% launch sale.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934800/a_pet_shop_after_dark/

Come work for a strange pet shop and be remunerated very handsomely so long as you don't stick your nose too far into places where it doesn't belong...

Awaiting you at the pet shop are...

 Little plants thirsty for water
 Hungry pets you cannot see
 Puzzles to enjoy in a safe working environment
We can't wait for you to join us... 🔍

notes.title: A HERO AND A GARDEN coming soon to Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41148008/3239c7e2e52cb454c9a8178c31a060150307b701.png

Hi! I'm going to be releasing another game on Steam called A HERO AND A GARDEN! It's a gardening visual novel and clicker game that was previously released on consoles, but the Steam version will have a new gameplay mode with remixed BGM. 

You play as a fairytale hero who tried to save a princess but failed miserably and got cursed instead. 

Features:
A really useless hero
Monsters who want to be your friend
Monsters who don't want to be your friend
Cute storybook-style art
Unlockable endless mode
Peaceful soundtrack to relax/harvest berries to
If you liked A YEAR OF SPRINGS, I hope you'll check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1914740/A_HERO_AND_A_GARDEN/

You can also always keep up with news from me by signing up for my newsletter! 
https://www.getrevue.co/profile/npckc

notes.title: A YEAR OF SPRINGS out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41148008/3e315c3b880288a53c877a8027cccd4c77aaba5b.png

Three women, three stories, three springs.

A YEAR OF SPRINGS is out NOW on Steam! Experience the stories of Haru, Erika, and Manami in this visual novel trilogy about a trio of friends navigating their feelings of love, connection, and just wanting to belong. 

FEATURES

 Three visual novels with multiple endings
 An all-new epilogue exclusive to the trilogy collection
 Soft and cute art with a relaxing original soundtrack
 Music player, CG gallery, and other extras
Check out the game & enjoy these three heartwarming stories now!

There's a week-long launch discount of 10% so don't miss it! There is also a bundle discount if you get the game and the soundtrack together.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22438/A_YEAR_OF_SPRINGS__Game__Soundtrack/
